steps.title: Culture HEK293T cells for lentivirus
steps.instruction: Seed 2 × 10⁶ HEK293T cells in a 6‑well plate, add normal growth media (DMEM + 10 % FBS + 1 % pen‑strep), and incubate at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Culture FIB control cells
steps.instruction: Seed 1 × 10⁷ mouse FIB cells in a 100 mm plate, add normal growth media, and incubate at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare feeder layer and culture iPSCs
steps.instruction: Coat a 100 mm plate with 2 mL of 0.1 % gelatin, incubate 37 °C for 2 h; wash twice with PBS and discard. Seed FIB cells on the coated plate and grow to ~70 % confluency. Add mitomycin C to a final concentration of 10 µg/mL, incubate 2 h, then wash twice with PBS. Seed 1 × 10⁶ iPSCs onto the feeder layer and culture in knockout growth media (KnockOut DMEM + 15 % KnockOut SR + 1 % MEM‑NEAA + 2 mM glutamine + 1 % pen‑strep + 200 µM β‑mercaptoethanol + ESGRO Mouse LIF) at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

substeps.instruction: Coat plate with 2 mL 0.1 % gelatin, 37 °C 2 h.
Seed FIB feeder cells, grow to ~70 % confluency.
Add mitomycin C (10 µg/mL), incubate 2 h.
Seed 1 × 10⁶ iPSCs on feeder, culture in knockout growth media at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Construct lenti-dCas9 plasmid with Sox2 gRNAs
steps.instruction: Design Sox2 gRNAs on the Broad Institute website, synthesize the pU6‑gRNA1‑pH1‑gRNA2 cassette using primers JH3915‑JH3986, JH3987‑JH3988, and JH3989‑J441 with PCR (95 °C 5 min; 32 × [95 °C 20 s, 62 °C 30 s, 72 °C 15 s]; 72 °C 10 min). Digest the lenti‑dCas9 vector and the PCR product with Age I and Not I at 37 °C for 30 min, ligate with T4 DNA ligase at 22 °C for 10 min, transform DH5α competent cells, verify the clone by sequencing, and purify plasmid using GeneAll Hybrid‑Q Plasmid Rapidprep.

substeps.instruction: Design gRNAs using the Broad Institute CRISPR design tool.
PCR‑amplify the gRNA cassette with primers JH3915‑JH3986, JH3987‑JH3988, JH3989‑J441 (95 °C 5 min; 32 × [95 °C 20 s, 62 °C 30 s, 72 °C 15 s]; 72 °C 10 min).
Digest vector and insert with Age I and Not I (37 °C 30 min).
Ligate digested fragments with T4 DNA ligase (22 °C 10 min).
Extract plasmid DNA using GeneAll Hybrid‑Q Plasmid Rapidprep.
